description: The Berlin Tiergarten network, one of the Berlin networks provided by R. Moehring, A. Schulz and N. Stier-Moses and used by Jahn et al. (2005), in H. Bar-Gera's TNTP version. From Transportation Networks for Research, the traffic assignment test networks that continue H. Bar-Gera's TNTP collection, read from the repository at commit d1639b4ef218 in the TNTP format: the network file's links are directed edges of type link carrying capacity, length, freeFlowTime, b, power, speed, toll, linkType, and nodes 1 to 26 are zones (type zone) and the rest of type node; each origin-destination entry of the trip table is a node of type commodity carrying its demand, joined by an origin edge and a destination edge to its two zones, zero entries included as the file lists them. The node coordinate files are not read.
